notes: Country: United States, certainty medium. Cues: US house-plan marketplace rendering ('Copyright By Designer'), modern farmhouse style, board-and-batten siding, standing-seam metal roof, 6-over-6 / 2-over-2 double-hung windows, single-storey wood-frame plan. No license plates, mailbox or text visible. Calc profile US.

All four inputs are architectural renderings (plan 140040RK), not photographs. Photo 4 is a later render version (file name 'Exterior-Render', different date) with visibly different wing proportions, shutters on the wing window, blinds and planting.

Chat-run triage: photo 1 = front, slightly angled from front-left, estimated yaw ~15 deg, occluded ~15% (porch posts, chairs, planting). Photo 2 = back, near frontal, occluded ~5%. Photo 3 = back (yaw ~25 deg) plus left gable end (yaw ~65 deg), steeply angled, occluded ~5%. Photo 4 = front, frontal, occluded ~25% (planting in front of wing and porch). Right elevation: not shown in any photo (100% unseen).
depth_basis: oblique_only - the left elevation is only visible steeply in photo 3; no frontal or slightly angled side view. DEPTH BASIS RULE applied.

Building reading: main body with side gable (ridge parallel to street) and a broken-pitch front roof: steep main slope down to the main front wall line, then a shallow porch roof over a full-width front porch with 4 doubled posts. Centered front gable dormer with two small windows. Lower side-gable wing on the right (from street), rear wall flush with main rear wall, front wall projecting ~1000 mm in front of the main front wall. Recessed covered rear porch cut into the main body with a 4-panel patio door.
Photo 4: right facade corner lies in the outer 10% of the frame (x~0.93) - possible lens compression of the wing width.
Consolidation done in-chat (weighted median, 10% outlier drop). Main footprint width = consolidated overall width minus estimated wing width 3100 mm.
